props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value. `null` is an empty field.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new moment, or `null` when the field is cleared.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the field and the picker panel. Pair with a Field for a visible label.

props.name: step
props.description: Minutes between the times offered in the list. Any minute can still be typed.

props.name: timeZoneLabel
props.description: The zone the value is read in — "Europe/London", "GMT+1". Shown beside the field so nobody guesses.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown while the field is empty.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the field as failing validation. Pair it with a message.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and dims the control.

props.name: id
props.description: Goes on the text input, so a Field label points at it.
